page.layout: Printed page 296, top left, with running head centred at top. Below, three columns side by side: left, a narrow column of italic event entries; middle, a table of consul names in groups separated by rules, with the years and symbols in a column at its right. Below the table, two full-width footnotes. The catchword "Claes" stands at the right, under the table.

p.i: Edfardus cum Brunfuigijs & Saxonibus transegit, arcemque Stichusam recepit.
‡ Henricus & Fridericus Gaikinga in cænobio Adoardia[?]-no a monachis occisi.
Controversia inter societates pleb. & cænobia per a-grum de opificijs composita.
Bellū inter Cam-penses & Suollenses orum, cui se Gel-drus miscuit. Bel-lum quoque in Fri-sia Occidentali rez[?] cruduit inter Bur-gund. & Geld.
* Ardente bello Carolus Geldriæ Dux Groningam venit.
† Doccumo & reliquis locis amissis, tandem Geldri Frisia Occidentali ejecti Duce Waffenario. Inducie inter Geld. & Burgund.
‡ Marwicus præfectus Geldriæ discordiæ femina jacit Groninge,

page.notes: The marks before the years are copied as seen: the first is a small dot or bullet (• 1518), the others are †, ‡, §, * and †, ‡. The § mark of 1521 may be a $ shape; [?] is marked where the letter is doubtful. Right margin: the year and symbol column is part of the table, not a note. The scan is slightly tilted and the lower edge is cut off at the foot. Printing errors left as printed: "Gaikinga", "Suollenses", "Inducie", "Doccumo". Long s is set as a plain s throughout.
